user.title: Connect to Eloverblik
user.description: Paste your Eloverblik key (eloverblik.dk calls it a token). Get one on eloverblik.dk: log in with MitID, open the menu with your name, choose "Datadeling" and then "Opret token".

meter.title: Choose your meter
meter.description: Pick the metering point to follow, and how much history to download the first time.

reauth_confirm.title: New Eloverblik key needed
reauth_confirm.description: Eloverblik no longer accepts the key (keys last up to a year and can be switched off). Create a new one on eloverblik.dk and paste it here.

error.invalid_auth: Eloverblik did not accept the key. Check that you copied all of it, or create a new one.
error.rate_limited: Eloverblik got too many requests (it allows a new login only twice a minute). Wait a minute and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Eloverblik. Try again in a few minutes.
error.no_meters: Eloverblik lists no linked meters for this key. Link your meter on eloverblik.dk (or with Power Monitor) and try again.
error.wrong_meter: This key doesn't give access to the meter this entry follows.

abort.already_configured: All meters for this key are already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: The new key works. Readings will keep coming in.
